info.title: voxd
info.description:
The local API behind VoxStudio. Everything the app does, your scripts can do too.

**Authentication:** send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request except
`GET /v1/status`. Audio URLs used directly in `<audio>` tags may pass `?token=<token>` instead.

**Errors** always look like `{"error": "<code>", "message": "<human text>"}`.

**Long work** runs as a job: queue it, then follow `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events` (server-sent events)
or the app-wide `WS /v1/events` stream.

get.description: Always answers, even while booting. Poll until `phase` is `ready`.
Hardware facts used to recommend models: chip, memory and free disk space.
Every downloadable model, whether it's installed, and how well it fits this computer.

schema.title: Response List Models V1 Models Get

post.description: Starts (or returns the already-running) download job. Interrupted downloads resume where they stopped.

delete.description: Deletes the model's files and frees the disk space. Takes made with it are kept.

post.description: Render short text (up to 5,000 characters) and wait for the result. For longer text use `POST /v1/jobs/speech`.

post.summary: Generate long speech in the background
post.description: Queue text of any length. Track it with `GET /v1/jobs/{id}/events`; on success `result` holds the `take_id` and `audio_url`.

get.description: Newest first. Page through history with `before`.

parameters.name: before

schema.description: Only takes created before this unix time — pass the last `created_at` to get the next page
schema.title: Before

parameters.description: Only takes created before this unix time — pass the last `created_at` to get the next page

post.description: Deletes the takes and their audio. Unknown ids are ignored; `deleted` lists what was removed.

post.summary: Save a take to a file
post.description: Copies the take's WAV to `path` (for example, a location picked in a save dialog).

patch.description: Only the fields you send change. A new `compute_device` applies the next time an engine starts.

schema.title: Response List Custom Voices V1 Voices Custom Get

post.summary: Create a voice from a recording
post.description: Stores the recording as a new voice that cloning engines (e.g. `chatterbox`) can speak with.

delete.description: Deletes the voice and its recording. Takes already made with it are kept.

post.description: Writes a portable `.voxvoice` file (recording, name, tags and consent record) to `path`.
Adds the voice to your library. The original consent record is kept alongside yours.

get.summary: All voices, with favorites and tags
get.description:
Every voice across installed engines plus your custom voices, with your favorites and tags.
Custom voices are listed even when no cloning engine is installed (`available: false`).

schema.title: Response Voice Library V1 Voices Library Get

put.description: Set `favorite` and/or `tags` for any voice. For custom voices pass their `cv_…` id (any `engine`).

get.description: Design needs a one-time analysis of Kokoro's voices (about a minute). Start it with `POST /v1/design/analyze`.

post.description:
Reads the description (plus any slider overrides) and returns up to four blends that match it.
Speak a candidate by passing its `recipe` as the `voice` with engine `kokoro`.

schema.title: Response List Designed Voices V1 Voices Designed Get

post.summary: Transcribe an audio or video file
post.description: Starts a transcription job. On success its `result.transcript_id` points to the transcript.

schema.title: Response List Transcriptions V1 Transcriptions Get

get.summary: Export as txt, srt, vtt or json

post.summary: Save an export to a file
post.description: Writes the transcript in `format` to `path` (which must end in `.<format>`).

schema.title: Response Dub Languages V1 Dubs Languages Get
Response List Dubs V1 Dubs Get

post.summary: Start a dub from a video or audio file
post.description: Uploads the file and starts preparing it (transcribe + translate). Watch `job_id`, then review and render.

patch.description: Edit lines (translation, speaker), the voice cast, the mix or the title. Any change after a render marks it `stale`.

post.description: Re-translates every line (optionally into a new target language). Your edits to translations are replaced.

get.summary: Source, dubbed audio/video, or a line preview

get.description: `which=translation` for the dubbed language, `which=text` for the original.

post.summary: Save an output to a file

schema.title: Response List Jobs V1 Jobs Get

delete.description: Deletes every job that is no longer queued or running. Takes they produced are kept.

post.description: Queued jobs cancel immediately; running jobs stop at their next checkpoint. Cancelling a finished job is a no-op.

get.description:
Server-sent events for one job: every past event after `after`, then live ones.
The stream closes after the job finishes. Reconnect with `after=<last seq>` to resume without gaps.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Only events with `seq` greater than this
